evidence: Matches the RPC/REST/ZMQ label and modifies JSON-RPC request parsing in src/rpc/request.cpp.
rationale: Fixes a JSON-RPC 2.0 batch parsing bug where malformed elements reuse preceding IDs or drop errors. Reviewers note this 'fixes something we missed from the jsonrpc 2.0 spec that could confuse consumers of the interface expecting unique IDs in batch responses', resolving an edge-case correctness issue in batch handling.
